title: Through on goal
text: You've beaten the last defender. Only the keeper is left, and a defender is chasing back.
tip: Glance at where the keeper is standing before you strike, then aim for the bigger gap.

options.why: Low shots into the corners are the hardest for a keeper to reach. Shoot early, before the defender catches you.
It can work, but every extra touch gives the chasing defender time to get back.

options.text: Stop and wait for a teammate
options.why: Stopping lets the defender recover. Chances like this don't last.
